fact: On 21 July 2026 BCEAO said it is finalising agreements for a six-month PAPSS pilot with more than 80 UEMOA commercial banks, with BCEAO taking part as an observer only.
title: BCEAO-PAPSS : plus de 80 banques mobilisées pour réduire la dépendance de l'UEMOA aux circuits de paiement extérieurs
